newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Aerodynamics boosts IPO terms.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Aerodynamics boosts IPO terms.

text.p: Advanced Aerodynamics & Structures Inc lifted terms of its coming initial public offering, according to a regulatory filing.
The Long Beach, Calif., company will offer 6.0 million units at $6.50 each. Previously, it planned to offer five million units at $5 each.
DH Blair Investment Banking Corp is the lead underwriter of the offering, which is due sometime this week.
The development-stage company designs and manufactures propjet and jet aircraft primarily for business use.
The shares would trade under "AASI" symbol on the Nasdaq.
